span.p:
1 · Published sources
Touché sweep + Arduino Touché circuit (Sato 2012, Honigman 2014)
body + footwear capacitance (Jonassen 1998, Maity 2019)
dry skin under a metal electrode (Goyal 2022) · watch return path (Datta 2020)
fabric, body-to-body, hand area (Ng 2017, Nath 2021, Agarwal 2010)
driven-shield residual (TI SNOA926) · ESP32 ADC noise

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sweep: 200 frequencies
f = 1 kHz + 17.5 kHz·k, up to 3.48 MHz

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Drive + LC tank
Y_src = 1 / (R_s + jωL), C_tank ≈ 104.5 pF

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Skin-electrode impedance
Z = 1/(Q_c (jω)^β) + R_sc ‖ 1/(Q_sc (jω)^α)
α ≈ 0.9, β ≈ 0.55, dry ↔ hydrated

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Couplings
C = ε₀ ε_r A / d (plates)
C_BE 110–250 pF · C_GE 0.4–2 pF · C_GB × shield

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Touch events
wrist · forearm · shoulder · own hand
railing · pole · phone · table · bystander · strap off

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4-node nodal solve, watch ground floats
nodes S · B · A · E
[Y]·V = I → V_S(f)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Change score
RMS over sweep of |V_now| − |V_base|
(% of full scale) + ADC noise
